title: Even or Odd
story: The ticket machine gives even-numbered tokens to the left queue and odd ones to the right.
goal: Read a whole number. Print even or odd.
starter:
n = int(input())
# print even or odd
hints: The remainder operator % gives what is left after division. What is the remainder of an even number divided by 2?
socratic: Which comparison tells you the remainder was zero?
Compare your output with the goal. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: what is the key idea in “Even or Odd”?
alt:
n = int(input())
print("even" if n % 2 == 0 else "odd")
